_comment: CaImAn pipeline template. Copy alongside <session>_pipeline.py and rename both. The session name is derived from the script filename — do not add session_id here.

env._comment: Applied before any caiman import. CAIMAN_* vars are forced; thread counts use setdefault so shell values take precedence.

session._comment: session_id is intentionally absent — it is the script filename stem minus _pipeline. Only structural paths live here.

data._comment: fr: acquisition frame rate [Hz]. decay_time: GCaMP decay constant [s] (GCaMP6f≈0.4, GCaMP6s≈1.0). add_baseline: constant added to all pixels during F→C conversion to keep values >0 for stable dF/F.

motion_correction._comment: pw_rigid: piecewise-rigid MC (false=rigid, recommended for most 2P). max_shifts: [row, col] px. border_nan: 'copy' replicates border pixels; 'min' fills with movie minimum.

cnmf._comment: See docs/configuration.md for full parameter descriptions. Ring constraint: ring_size_factor × gSiz[0] must be < rf.

quality._comment: Components must pass all enabled criteria. use_cnn is auto-disabled if model files are missing.

cluster._comment: n_processes: null=auto (all CPUs). Reduce ram_budget_frac if workers OOM. Lower worker_overhead_frac if actual worker RAM < estimated.

gpu._comment: precompute_chunk_frames: frames per GPU filter chunk. Peak VRAM ≈ 2 × frames × d1 × d2 × 4 bytes. Reduce if GPU OOM during precompute.
